sections.demographics: Active members by age and gender

intros.overview: Each figure is compared with last season up to the same date.
intros.outingsMonthly: Number of outings each month, compared with the same month last season.
intros.activeRowersMonthly: Number of different rowers who went out at least once in the month, compared with last season.
intros.demographics: Club members who went out at least once in the season, by age group and gender (guests are not counted). Juniors: 18 or under.
intros.fleet: Average number of outings per boat for each boat class: the higher it is, the busier the boats of that class.
intros.topBoats: Number of outings of each boat over the season.
intros.routes: Number of outings per route (outings logged without a route are not counted).
intros.outingTypes: Number of outings per type: learn-to-row, training, racing, touring…
intros.incidents: Number of incidents reported for each boat concerned.
intros.damages: Damage reported during the season, per boat and by severity.
intros.retention: Share of rowers still active one and two seasons after they joined.
intros.safety: Outings back late, without an expected return time or never closed in the logbook, month by month. One outing can appear in two categories.

introsAlone.activeRowersMonthly: Number of different rowers who went out at least once in the month.

empty.incidents: No incident reported during the season.
empty.damages: No damage reported during the season.
empty.safety: No late return or unclosed outing during the season.

omitted: No data this season, not printed: {{titles}}.

notesFor.demographics: {{members}} club members out of {{active}} active rowers; the {{guests}} guests are not counted here.
notesFor.retentionBoth: {{arrivals}} new rowers in {{season}}; {{pct}} of those who joined in {{prev}} came back this season.
notesFor.retentionReturned: {{pct}} of those who joined in {{prev}} came back this season.
notesFor.retentionFirst: The first season on record holds every member who was already there.
notesFor.firstSeason: First season recorded in Rowing Beacon: no comparison with last season.
notesFor.partialMonth: {{month}}: month in progress, data up to {{date}}.
notesFor.incidentsOneBoat: {{count}} incidents reported, all on the same boat.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.activeRower: Active rower: anyone who went out in a boat at least once during the season, member or guest.
definitions.coached: Coached outing: an outing marked as coached in the logbook; the share counts only outings where this is filled in.
definitions.hours: Hours on the water: duration of single-day outings; outings over several days are not counted.
definitions.km: Kilometers: distances entered in the logbook.

footer: Generated by Rowing Beacon from the club's logbook.
pdfBanner: To get a PDF: Print (Ctrl+P, or ⌘P on a Mac), destination "Save as PDF". Untick "Headers and footers" for a clean result.

htmlSavedNotOpened: Page saved to Downloads ({{name}}): open it, then Print › Save as PDF.
failedSections_one: {{count}} section could not be computed and is not in the document: {{titles}}.
failedSections_other: {{count}} sections could not be computed and are not in the document: {{titles}}.
